description: Shell string master. `spec` holds GDD-07 §5.11 verbatim (tools/check_strings.py asserts byte-for-byte parity with the spec document). `build` holds strings this pixel build introduces.

spec.STR_NEW_BODY: A signed contract already exists: "{0} — {1}, {2}, {3}". Starting anew will not erase it; up to 8 contracts may rest in the ledger.
